thread:
Ivy: quick note 10:12 0240UTC - noticed sampleapp and SDKs show inconsistent errors. customers get '500' or generic ServerError with no guidance.

Ned: can you give a short repro?

Ivy: call /v1/generate with a bad prompt and expired model slot. js: throws Error('500'); py: raises ServerError({'code':'server_error','message':'internal error'}). frontend shows 'Request failed'.

Priya: that's bad. proposal: normalized envelope with fields: code(enum), http_status, message, human_action, retryable(bool), error_id. Keep error.message backward-compatible for a release to avoid breaking partners.

Ned: mapping idea: 429 -> RATE_LIMIT (retryable, include retry_after), 502/503 -> TRANSIENT (retryable), model-run 5xx -> MODEL_FAILURE (non-retryable). unknown -> UNKNOWN_ERROR fallback.

Ivy: sampleapp UX: show friendly copy like "Something went wrong. Try again in a moment." and a small "Details" toggle that reveals error_id + dev-only stack. do not show stack by default.

Priya: add short human_action hints: 'Retry in 30s', 'Reconnect account', 'Contact support with error_id'. make them one-liners.

sdk-bot: created issue #5021: "sdk: unify error shape + sampleapp friendly copy" https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/5021

Ned: tech tasks: python typed exceptions (RateLimitError, TransientError, ModelFailureError), js Error subclass with same fields, sampleapp tweak, telemetry emit code+error_id. add tests for mapping 429 and 502.

Ivy: also ensure retry middleware reads retryable flag and retry_after when present. do not auto-retry on AUTH 401/403.

Priya: dev note: keep stable snake_case codes (e.g. model_failure) so UI can map to translations.

Ned: I'll take js client shim. Ivy, can you own python and sampleapp bits?

Ivy: yep, i'll file smaller PRs. aim for EOD local.

Priya: +1. thanks all :shipit:
